description: This PHP script is a command-line installer for the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. It handles checking dependencies, reading configuration files, initializing system components, setting up database connection info, creating the database, applying migrations, and creating initial system configurations and admin user data.

classes.name: HttpKernel
classes.description: Initializes the HTTP kernel environment for the installer, setting environment mode and error handling.

classes.name: MemorySessionStorage
classes.description: Implements session storage using memory, used for session handling.

classes.name: Session
classes.description: Manages user session lifecycle, starting and storing session data.

classes.name: ServiceContainer
classes.description: Dependency injection container for managing application services.

classes.name: Services
classes.description: Enumeration or collection of service identifiers used within the container.

classes.name: AppSetupUtility
classes.description: Utility class providing methods to set up the database, run migrations, configure system settings, and create configuration files.

classes.name: UserCredential
classes.description: Data transfer object representing user credentials (username + password).

classes.name: Request
classes.description: Represents an HTTP request object, configured here for POST method.

classes.name: InstallerDataRegistrationAPI
classes.description: Handles registration API during installation, likely to finalize configuration or registration steps.

methods.name: storeDbInfo
methods.description: Stores database connection details into the state container.

methods.name: setDbType
methods.description: Sets the type of database being used (new or existing).

methods.name: storeInstanceData
methods.description: Stores organization and location info for the system instance.

methods.name: storeAdminUserData
methods.description: Stores administrator account information for initial setup.

methods.name: createDatabase
methods.description: Creates the database if it does not exist.

methods.name: runMigrations
methods.description: Applies the latest database schema migrations.

methods.name: createDBUser
methods.description: Creates a database user for OrangeHRM.

methods.name: writeConfFile
methods.description: Generates configuration files necessary for system operation.

methods.name: writeKeyFile
methods.description: Creates encryption keys if data encryption is enabled.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Method to process the registration API request.
